mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(old_salary),0) AS currentSalary, COALESCE(SUM(increase_salary),0) AS increaseSalary, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount),0) AS receiveSalary FROM payrolls WHERE is_active = 1 AND employee_id IN (SELECT id FROM employees WHERE is_active = 1 AND paid_by = 1) AND ( employee_id IN ( SELECT employee_id FROM employee_apply_status AS eas WHERE eas.is_active = 1 AND eas.employee_status_id NOT IN(4,5,6) ) OR employee_id IN ( SELECT employee_id FROM employee_apply_status AS eas WHERE eas.is_active = 1 AND eas.employee_status_id IN (4,5,6) AND MONTH(eas.date) > MONTH(#{filter.date}) AND YEAR(eas.date) >= YEAR(#{filter.date}) )OR employee_id IN ( SELECT pr.employee_id FROM payrolls AS pr WHERE pr.is_active = 1 AND pr.employee_id = employee_id AND MONTH(pr.pay_date) = MONTH(#{filter.date}) AND YEAR(pr.pay_date) = YEAR(#{filter.date}) ) ) AND MONTH(pay_date) = MONTH(#{filter.date}) AND YEAR(pay_date) = YEAR(#{filter.date})

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM payroll_details WHERE is_active = 1 AND payroll_item_id = #{payrollItemId} AND payroll_id IN (SELECT id FROM payrolls WHERE is_active = 1 AND MONTH(pay_date) = MONTH(#{payDate}) AND YEAR(pay_date) = YEAR(#{payDate}) AND employee_id IN (SELECT id FROM employees WHERE is_active = 1 AND paid_by = 1) )
